content.text:
Suspense now starts every Claude Code run with your claude.ai account's connectors turned off, so a run never hears that a connector needs authorizing and can't pass that on. All 519 tests pass, including new ones for this. I didn't run a real Claude Code task to watch the notice disappear, since that would cost a paid request.

**The setting:**
- **Name:** the spec step wasn't sure of it, so I searched the installed Claude Code (2.1.281 here, and 2.1.289 in your local versions). It does read `ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS`, and treats `false` as "connectors off".
- **Where it's set:** in the environment of every Claude Code run:
  - **Tasks and questions,** started in `src/harness.rs`.
